_about: The ShipLoop entry-card split ledger (efficiency plan unit U22, rev 4 Step 3.5b). The 83,199-byte skills/shiploop/SKILL.md kept binding, start and recovery, ownership, the callback and the authority limits; every other section moved, text unchanged except relative links and heading level, into a purpose file of at most 8,192 bytes under skills/shiploop/references/, opened behind a one-line trigger the card prints. One row per moved obligation: the card section it left (old), the file and section it lives in now (home, section), the card text that sends a reader there (trigger), and anchor phrases that prove it is present (whitespace-normalised). Nothing was deleted. test/shiploop-package-integrity.test.py (EntryCardSplitTests) checks every row, that every section of a split file has a row, and the size bounds. A unit that moves or rewords a moved obligation changes its row in the same commit. Snapshot: INT 9f949689.
